name: TPS3823-33DBVR
title: TPS3820, TPS3823, TPS3824, TPS3825, TPS3828: SOT-23 voltage supervisors with watchdog
summary: A family of five-pin SOT-23 supply supervisors with fixed thresholds for 2.5 V, 3 V, 3.3 V and 5 V rails. Each keeps its reset output asserted while VDD is low and for a fixed delay (200 ms, or 25 ms on the TPS3820) after it recovers; versions add a watchdog input (1.6 s or 200 ms), a manual reset input, an active-high second output or an open-drain output. Supply current is 15 µA typical over a 1.1 V to 5.5 V supply. TPS3823-33DBVR is the TPS3823 with a 2.93 V threshold, push-pull active-low /RESET, watchdog and /MR, on a 3000-piece reel.

notes: The two digits after the hyphen give the threshold: -25 2.25 V, -30 2.63 V, -33 2.93 V, -50 4.55 V. DBVR is a 3000-piece reel, DBVT a 250-piece reel; G4 and .A are further orderable variants.
Delay td is 200 ms typical on all but the TPS3820 (25 ms).

pins.name: /RESET
pins.function: Reset output, active low. Push-pull on all devices except the TPS3828, where it is open-drain.

pins.name: /MR
pins.function: Manual reset, active low, with an internal pull-up to VDD (90 kΩ typical). Holding it low forces reset; reset stays asserted while it is low and for td after it returns high. Unused, it is left open or tied to VDD.

pins.name: WDI
pins.function: Watchdog input. A falling edge restarts the watchdog timer, and asserting reset also clears it. If the input stays at one level longer than ttout, reset is asserted. Left floating, the device pulses the input internally so no watchdog reset occurs; the input has to be driven high or low for the watchdog to act.

circuits.title: TPS3823-33 supervising an MSP430C325
circuits.description: The supervisor and the MSP430C325 share a 3.3 V rail with a 100 nF capacitor across it. /RESET drives the microcontroller's reset input; an I/O pin of the microcontroller toggles WDI to keep the watchdog satisfied. A push button from /MR to ground gives a manual reset.

circuits.title: Supply rail monitoring with watchdog time-out
circuits.description: The same arrangement with the TPS3823A-33. /RESET holds the MSP430C325 in reset until VDD has risen over VIT- + VHYS and td has passed, and asserts it again when VDD falls under VIT- or when the I/O line feeding WDI stops changing for longer than ttout. The 100 nF capacitor across the rail guards the reset line against a noisy supply.

circuits.title: WDI cut off from the processor during reset
circuits.description: A TPS3820-33 (25 ms delay) supervises a processor on a 3.3 V rail. An N-channel MOSFET sits in series between the processor's I/O pin and WDI, its gate on the /RESET line. While /RESET is low the FET is off and the processor's toggling never reaches WDI, so a non-A device does not stay latched in reset; when /RESET goes high the FET conducts and the watchdog sees the I/O line. A capacitor from the rail to ground decouples the supply, and a push button on /MR gives a manual reset.
notes: Q1's source is on the WDI side, where its body connection is joined.

operation.text: From VDD = 1.1 V upward /RESET is driven to its active state. It stays active while VDD is below VIT-, the threshold set inside by a resistor divider and a reference, so no external parts are needed to set it. Once VDD climbs past VIT- + VHYS an internal timer runs for td (200 ms typical, 25 ms on the TPS3820) before the output is released. When VDD falls back below VIT-, reset is asserted again. On the TPS3824 and TPS3825 the RESET output does the reverse: high during reset, low otherwise.
Fixed thresholds suit 2.5 V, 3 V, 3.3 V and 5 V rails: VIT- of 2.25 V, 2.63 V, 2.93 V and 4.55 V typical for the -25, -30, -33 and -50 versions.
A low level on /MR (TPS3820, TPS3823, TPS3823A, TPS3825, TPS3828) asserts reset whatever the state of VDD or the watchdog, and reset is held for td after /MR returns high.
Every device has an active-low /RESET; the TPS3824 and TPS3825 add an active-high RESET. All outputs are push-pull except on the TPS3828, whose /RESET is open-drain.

Inside the part a resistor divider from VDD feeds a comparator with hysteresis against VREF, which drives the reset logic. /MR is pulled up to VDD through 52 kΩ, and WDI connects through 40 kΩ to an auto-reset oscillator and into a transition detector that feeds the watchdog timer logic.

On the TPS3820, TPS3823, TPS3823A, TPS3824 and TPS3828, WDI has to see a falling edge within ttout (1.6 s typical, 200 ms on the TPS3820). If it does not, reset is asserted for td and the watchdog timer starts again.

Leaving WDI unconnected turns the watchdog off: the device senses the high-impedance input and pulses it internally, so reset is never asserted by the watchdog. To make the device treat WDI as driven instead, a 1 kΩ resistor goes from WDI to ground.

operation.topic: WDI activity during reset, and the A version
operation.text: On the TPS3820, TPS3823, TPS3824 and TPS3828, if WDI keeps toggling while /RESET is asserted, /RESET latches low and stays low after VDD has recovered above VIT-. The TPS3823A does not latch in this case. Where WDI must stay active during reset on a non-A device, an N-channel FET in series with WDI, gated by /RESET, disconnects WDI while reset is asserted. The TPS3823A works with or without that FET and can replace the non-A part.
The supply range is 1.1 V to 5.5 V. If the supply is noisy, a 0.1 µF ceramic capacitor close to VDD is recommended.

The VDD decoupling capacitor goes close to the device. A long VDD trace adds inductance that, with the decoupling capacitor, forms an LC tank that can ring with peaks above the VDD maximum rating, so the VDD trace is kept short.

In the DBV layout example for the TPS3828, CVDD connects pin 5 (VDD) to ground right beside the pin; pin 1 (/RESET) carries the reset flag and a pull-up resistor to the pull-up voltage; pin 2 goes to ground; pins 3 (/MR) and 4 (WDI) run out to their signals.
The TPS3820 gives a shorter reset pulse (td 25 ms typical) where 200 ms is too long. The TPS3828 takes the place of the TPS3823A where an open-drain output is needed.
Q100-qualified versions exist: TPS3820-Q1, TPS3823-Q1, TPS3824-Q1, TPS3825-Q1 and TPS3828-Q1.
